title: Biased split-cube probability distribution
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $p\in[0,1]$. On pairs of sign assignments, take the product distribution in which each sign in both blocks is drawn independently from the biased sign distribution with parameter $p$: the first block has two coordinates and the second has $2m+1$ coordinates.
